args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production release (error rate about 0.18 at time of check). Per the platform runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent production release that was healthy, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback status: rolled_out, all three regions now on v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. Follow-up: confirm checkout-api health and error rate recovery on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollout reports `rolled_out`.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy production release, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. It describes the v2.3.1 failure (error rate about 0.18 at the time of check), the rollback to v2.3.0, and the regions affected.

I did not re-check health or error rate after the rollback, so recovery is unconfirmed. Someone should verify that checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 and investigate v2.3.1 before it is released again.
